_note: Sahel, the Coast Edition: garment measurements from the charts Faheem supplied on 27 Oct 2026. S to XL only (we do not make 2XL). Inches as supplied; cm = inches x 2.54, except the hoodie, whose cm figures are as supplied.

teeRegular.label: Sahel tees, Regular fit
teeRegular.intent: A straight regular fit for everyday wear and a classic look.

teeOversized.label: Sahel tees, Oversized fit
teeOversized.intent: A loose, relaxed cut, wider through the body than the Regular fit.

hoodie.label: Sahel hoodies
hoodie.intent: A relaxed oversized fit, cut unisex: dropped shoulder, roomy chest, relaxed sleeves and a loose body.

method: Chest: garment laid flat, measured straight across 1″ below the armhole. Double it for the full chest.
Length: from the highest point of the shoulder down to the bottom hem.
Shoulder (hoodies): straight across from one shoulder seam to the other.
Sleeve: from the shoulder seam to the sleeve opening.
Hem and cuff (hoodies): the opening measured flat, straight across.

compare.teeRegular: Sahel is cut on its own pattern and runs larger than the Founding Edition: a Sahel Regular S is 22″ across the chest, a Founding Edition Regular S is 19″. Go by the measurement, not the size you took before.
compare.teeOversized: Sahel is cut on its own pattern and runs larger than the Founding Edition: a Sahel Oversized S is 24″ across the chest, a Founding Edition Oversized S is 22.5″. Go by the measurement, not the size you took before.
compare.hoodie: The hoodies are new to the range, so there is no Founding Edition size to compare with. Measure a hoodie you like flat and match the numbers.
